reason: Review finding 2 fix: the adoption-void and RUNNER_UNAVAILABLE re-merge sites count the commits the head-failure cascade is about to kill as dead (worker.py::_cascade_doomed_commits, threaded as doomed= through the claim and dead-base chains), so a replacement and the merger's held base are never re-anchored on an inflight entry that dies moments later.
